$Comment: Tells the mod what this pack does to each of ITS OWN content stores. 'add' merges what is here
alongside everything already loaded; 'replace' would throw the existing content away first.
List every MMOSkillTree store the pack ships files into. A store that is shipped but not listed
is a store whose files quietly do nothing.
Contracts, boards, wallets, storefronts, shelves and offers are NOT listed: those stores belong
to the shared framework rather than to the mod, and they merge by id on their own. To retune one
somebody else shipped, drop in a file of the same id, or ship a file naming theirs as its Parent;
to take one out, ship a file of that id with "Enabled": false. This pack currently ships no
content into a store the mod itself owns, so this file names none.
Name: MMOSkillBountyPack
